item.title: Vance campaigns in Iowa as GOP faces tight races
item.description: Vice President J.D. Vance told Iowa voters to keep supporting Republicans this midterm season, arguing Democrats cannot be trusted to protect farmland.

item.title: Thousands of Noncitizens on New Jersey Voter Rolls Called 'Tip of the Iceberg'
item.description: Rep. Jeff Van Drew, R-NJ, said during a hearing that the presence of noncitizens on New Jersey's voter rolls amounts to a cover-up.

item.title: Kevin Warsh Discusses Inflation in the Correct Manner
item.description: Rising prices are not an unavoidable consequence of a strong economy.

item.description: President Trump should take time to consider how the U.S. has reached this point.
